pr930ProductionVerification.whyItMattersMore: #930 was a P1: src/ros/championship.py's playoff field was `len([s for s in seeded_owners if seeded_owners.index(s) < 6]) or 6`, now `min(playoff_seeds, len(seeded_owners))`. In a 7-seed league three real qualifiers were assigned an 'out' finish, i.e. structurally incapable of winning.
pr930ProductionVerification.blockerThisAuditorFound: THE DEPLOY ALONE DOES NOT CLOSE IT. The championship payload is not computed per-request: `src/ros/scrape.py:372` calls `championship.simulate_championship_odds(...)` and writes the payload as a pipeline artifact. So the corrected code only reaches served numbers after a POST-DEPLOY ROS SCRAPE regenerates it. Until that scrape runs, production can be correctly deployed and still be serving the pre-fix bracket — a deployed-but-not-yet-EFFECTIVE state, distinct from deployed-but-not-verified.
